title: School for Sale in Aruvadai, India
tagline: Located in Aruvadai, our school has been a trusted choice for families for the past 10 years. - Operates as a private nursery and primary school, recognized by the Tamil Nadu Directorate of Private Schools. - Currently has around 150 students enrolled across classes LKG to V, with English as the medium of instruction. - Employs 23 teaching and non-teaching staff, engaged on a non-permanent basis. - School recognition has been renewed for classes LKG to V and remains valid for up to another 2 years. - Generates revenue primarily through student fees, with annual sales of approximately INR 51 lakh. - Provides a nurturing learning environment focused on students’ academic development and overall growth.
